caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. This object is a container or dish shaped like a duck sitting on top of a rounded bowl. The bowl has decorative details, including a pattern of diamond shapes and a rope-like edge running around its rim. The duck, which forms the lid, has a smooth body with a subtle outline of a wing on its side and a rounded head with a beak and a single, small, circular eye. The entire drawing is rendered in light shades of gray and muted blue, giving the object a soft, monochromatic appearance, with line work used to define the patterns and contours. The name "LeRoy Griffith" is written in small, capitalized letters near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Covered Dish (Duck)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
